title: Venezuelan-Style Fish Wrap
description: Crisp fried fish in a flavorful Venezuelan-inspired wrap.
instructions: 1. Cut the fish into thin strips and marinate in a mixture of lime juice, garlic powder, and cumin for at least 30 minutes.
2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the marinated fish to the skillet and cook until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
4. Warm the wrap in the skillet for 1-2 minutes, until soft and pliable.
5. Assemble the wrap by placing the fried fish in the center and topping with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
